title: Add demo tenant healthcheck endpoint + human-readable report
author: Devon Price
description: Motivation: SEs need a single, deterministic way to confirm the demo tenant is ready before a live call and after running reset/seed. We’ve had repeated issues where the "happy path" fails due to (a) quota/rate limit misconfig causing 429s mid-demo (SUP-4127), (b) model pin drift / catalog changes, and (c) Console dashboards appearing empty because ingestion is delayed or the synthetic traffic generator is not running (SUP-4189). This PR adds a demo-scoped healthcheck endpoint and a corresponding human-readable report that consolidates the checks we currently do manually across several internal pages and scripts. Summary of changes: 1) New endpoint: GET /internal/demo/healthcheck (admin-only) and GET /internal/demo/healthcheck/report (text/plain) that runs a short suite of read-only checks against the demo org/project(s). 2) Checks included: (a) Quota + rate limit sanity for demo projects (token/min, req/min, concurrent streams), (b) Model availability for pinned demo routes (including region-specific availability and safe fallback compatibility), (c) Telemetry ingestion freshness (usage events and latency histograms arriving for demo project in the last N minutes), (d) Synthetic traffic job status (last heartbeat + config preset), (e) Auth/RBAC validation (demo roles mapped and SE runner role can list projects), (f) Console data sources sanity (dashboard queries return non-empty series for the default time window). 3) Guard rails: endpoint returns 403 unless caller has internal-admin and the tenant is flagged demo=true; refuses to run against non-demo orgs (prevents accidental prod pokes). 4) Output format: machine-readable JSON for automation and a colorless text report intended to be pasted into Slack during triage. 5) Wire-up: demo reset CLI and runbook can call the JSON endpoint and gate success on required checks (the CLI integration will land in follow-up; this PR provides the endpoint + tests + docs stubs). Endpoint behavior details: - Default time window for telemetry freshness is 15 minutes (configurable via ?freshness_minutes=). - Model checks evaluate both "pinned" and "fallback" candidates and report mismatches explicitly (e.g., pinned unavailable in eu-west, fallback eligible: yes/no). - Quota checks compare current settings to a demo baseline profile (demo_standard_v1) and return WARN if values deviate, FAIL if values are below minimum. - Telemetry checks query the metrics backend via existing internal client; failures are isolated per check so we can return partial results with a top-level overall_status. Example JSON (abbrev): {"overall_status":"WARN","generated_at":"2025-11-18T01:12:04Z","org":"demo-redwood","checks":[{"name":"quota","status":"PASS","details":"req/min=600 OK, concurrent_streams=50 OK"},{"name":"models","status":"PASS","details":"pinned: rw-chat-1.3.2 available us-east/eu-west"},{"name":"telemetry_freshness","status":"WARN","details":"latest_usage_event_age=19m > 15m threshold"},{"name":"synthetic_traffic","status":"PASS","details":"last_heartbeat=2m, preset=dashboard_populate_v2"}]}. Example report output (abbrev): DEMO TENANT HEALTHCHECK (demo-redwood) Overall: WARN Generated: 2025-11-18T01:12:04Z Quota ............ PASS Models ........... PASS Telemetry ......... WARN (latest usage event 19m ago; threshold 15m) Synthetic traffic .. PASS Notes: If Telemetry WARN persists, run: redwood-internal demo-traffic --preset dashboard_populate_v2 --duration 5m and re-check. Testing: - Unit tests for each check evaluator (quota baselines, model pin resolver, telemetry freshness thresholds). - Integration test with a local stubbed metrics client. - Added a lightweight contract test to ensure we never run against non-demo tenants. Rollout: This endpoint is internal-only and not exposed in customer environments. It is safe to deploy behind the internal gateway and will be referenced by the demo reset runbook once merged. Follow-ups: - Hook this endpoint into the bootstrap/reset CLI (ENG-4862) so the command exits non-zero on FAIL. - Add alerting for persistent WARN/FAIL in demo environment (ENG-4879).

conversation: Markus Klein (review): This is exactly what SEs have been asking for. Two asks: (1) Make the report output stable for copy/paste (no ANSI colors), (2) Include the project slug in the output since we sometimes run parallel demos. Devon Price (author): Ack. Report is plain text only; added project field per check and included org + default project at top. Sean Gallagher (review): On quotas, can we differentiate WARN vs FAIL? I want FAIL only when we’re below demo minimums; WARN for deviations above baseline (so we don’t block a demo). Devon Price: Updated quota check: FAIL if any min thresholds not met; WARN if above/below baseline but still above mins; PASS if within baseline band. Added test cases. Chloe Martin (review): The Console probe makes me nervous: don’t call expensive queries. Can we keep it to a single lightweight query against the pre-aggregated series? Devon Price: Swapped probe to the pre-agg endpoint and limited to last 60m window. Added a 2s timeout and isolation so it can’t hang the whole healthcheck. Ethan Park (review): Auth guard looks good. Please also log who called the endpoint (audit trail) and include a request_id. Devon Price: Added audit log event DEMO_HEALTHCHECK_RUN with actor + org_id + request_id; request_id propagated to response. Allison Grant (review): For telemetry freshness, if metrics backend is down we should return WARN not FAIL (demo can proceed in backup mode). Devon Price: Done; telemetry backend errors now WARN with details="metrics backend unavailable" and overall_status escalates to WARN unless another FAIL exists. CI: First run failed on typecheck due to metrics-client import cycle; fixed in follow-up commit and re-ran. Final approvals: Sean approved after quota status change; Markus approved after report formatting; Chloe approved after query change; Ethan approved after audit log addition. Merge: Squash merged to main.
release_notes: Internal-only: adds demo tenant healthcheck endpoints (/internal/demo/healthcheck and /internal/demo/healthcheck/report) to validate quota, model availability, and dashboard/telemetry readiness before live demos.
